svg.title: The creator compares two printed source pages at night
svg.desc: Return to the same office geometry with two printed source pages and the model interface. The desk is a reconstructed review setting, not an incident witness room. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
